label: first copy step echoing a leading b, when the next outputs are 3/l/o/2
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.015% of steps) that fires only in the copy phase, mostly (89% of mass) at the step right after <DEL>, where the input is the echoed first token and the model is about to output token 1. The echoed token is b in 72% of activations; a, e, k, y and v account for most of the rest. Within that slot it also depends on the upcoming outputs: it is enriched when the token being output is 3, l or o, or the next one is o, 2 or 3. The strongest examples are b followed by 3/l/o. A few weaker activations occur at recall_idx 2-3 on a repeated token. It never fires in the original phase or at the delimiter, and never on a token appearing for the first time. Being b at the first copy step is not enough: only about 3.5% of those steps are active, so the feature looks like a thresholded conjunction of first token b and o/3/l/2 coming up. Restricting to the predicate pulls precision up to about 15% but drops about half the mass; the rest is the other leading letters and other continuations.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=b (+5.14), orig3=o (+2.99), phase=2 & in_tok=e (+2.89), phase=2 & out_tok=l (+2.76), orig4=o (+2.59), orig0=a (+2.57). Lower it: orig1=m (-2.28), next_out=- (-1.63), in_count=2 (-1.06).
